game.name: Link
game.rules:
-Use the link in Resources (CrazyGames).

-Touch screen play is NOT allowed.

-Do not submit every individual IL from a longer video, unless they are already retimed.

-The ILs from replays may be retimed automatically by moderator. To be elligable for automatic retiming, the game capture has to be of sufficient quality. Replays where the height of the game doesn't exceed 360 pixels (half the height of 720p or third the height of 1080p layouts) may be rejected from automatic retiming.

-The entire game, including all the GUI elements, have to be visible throughout the run.
